consolidate_checkpoints: consolidate all FSDP distributed checkpoints in a directory into a single consolidated.pth file
load_from_checkpoint: load a model and optional optimizer state from a distributed checkpoint directory using dcp.load
CheckpointManager_save: save the model state dict, optimizer state dict, config, and train state to a timestamped checkpoint folder
CheckpointManager_load: load model, optimizer, and train state from the last saved checkpoint or a specified path
CheckpointManager_clean_up: clean up old checkpoint folders keeping only the most recent dump and eval checkpoints based on keep count
